shrayjaiswal050-design opened PR #14798 from shrayjaiswal050-design:fix/x64-i64x2-narrow to bytecodealliance:main:

Fixes #4734.

The x64 backend was missing the general snarrow and unarrow lowerings for i64x2 inputs. As a result, valid i64x2 -> i32x4 operations failed during compilation.

This adds SSE2-compatible lowerings that:

  • Saturate signed values for snarrow.
  • Treat unarrow inputs as signed i64 values and clamp them to [0, u32::MAX].
  • Preserve the expected lane order.
  • Keep the existing optimized conversion-specific lowerings.

Tests cover saturation boundaries, negative values, lane ordering, loaded values, and live inputs.

Checks:

  • 702 x64/runtime/egraph filetests passed.
  • 204 Cranelift codegen unit tests passed.
  • cargo fmt -p cranelift-codegen -- --check
  • git diff --check

:memo: cfallin submitted PR review:

Thanks! These lowerings look fine to me. Just a nit on the test below.

:speech_balloon: cfallin created PR review comment:

Can we add other architectures too if they support this instruction? And at least the Cranelift interpreter, too (and let's add support there if we're missing this case).
:memo: shrayjaiswal050-design submitted PR review.

:speech_balloon: shrayjaiswal050-design created PR review comment:

Thanks, good point. I’ll extend the test coverage to the other backends that support i64x2 snarrow/unarrow, and make sure the Cranelift interpreter handles and exercises these cases as well. I’ll update the test matrix and rerun the relevant file tests.
